items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer:
The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2]

Clause 14.2 of the MSA requires Provider to provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client. [1]

The notice was sent in accordance with Clause 22.1, which specifies that any notice under the Agreement shall be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party. [6]

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.
Provider shall provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client in accordance with Clause 22.
Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party at the address set out in Schedule 4.

evidence.quote: Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer:
The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2]

Additionally, Clause 14.2 of the MSA requires Provider to provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client. [1].

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.
Provider shall provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client in accordance with Clause 22.

items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer: The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. Clause 5.1 states that the agreement "continues until terminated," and Clause 5.2 allows either party to terminate the agreement with 60 days' written notice [1][1].

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated.
Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The storage agreement's terms that remain in force after Amendment No. 1 include all terms except those specifically amended. The document states, "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [1].

The original Storage Services Agreement included terms such as the monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 [3], the right to terminate with 60 days' notice [3], and liability capped at EUR 150,000 per event [3].

Other documents, such as the Northbridge NDA and Harrowgate MSA, are separate agreements and not part of the storage agreement. The Northbridge NDA includes a term of three years and continued obligations for five years after termination [2][2]. The Harrowgate MSA includes a term of 36 months with automatic renewal [4][4].

The Unit 7 Lease specifies the use of the premises for storage and distribution [6].

evidence.quote: All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer: The documents state that Jonas Ekberg was not sure of the exact minute the alarm sounded. He recalls the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026, but he is not sure of the exact minute [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer: The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000. This is stated in the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement [2].
